title: 富士山や北海道の紅葉も！日本の 8つの紅葉ツアー
titleTranslation: Autumn Leaves at Mt. Fuji and Hokkaido Too! 8 Autumn Foliage Tours in Japan
summary: The article introduces eight day-trip bus tours across Japan — from Hokkaido and Tohoku to the Mt. Fuji area, greater Tokyo, and Fukuoka — for enjoying autumn foliage together with local nature, food, and cultural sites.

sentences.text: 秋に　日本の　いろいろな　場所で　きれいな　紅葉を　みることが　できます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means
to see, to look (kana form of 見る)

sentences.translation: In autumn, you can see beautiful autumn leaves in various places across Japan.

sentences.text: この記事では、北海道、東北、富士山のちかく、東京、福岡の　8つの　紅葉ツアーを　しょうかいします。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: In this article, we introduce 8 autumn-leaf tours in Hokkaido, Tohoku, near Mt. Fuji, Tokyo, and Fukuoka.

sentences.text: 日本では　北は　北海道から、南は　九州まで、日本の　いろいろな　場所で　きれいな　紅葉を　見ることが　できます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means
particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: In Japan, from Hokkaido in the north to Kyushu in the south, you can see beautiful autumn leaves in many different places.

sentences.text: この記事では、日本で　楽しむことが　できる　8つの　紅葉ツアーと　アクティビティを　紹介します。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means
particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: In this article, we introduce 8 autumn-leaf tours and activities you can enjoy in Japan.

sentences.text: この記事で　紹介した　ツアーに　参加しなければ　行くことが　できないような　場所も　あります。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: There are also places you can only reach by joining the tours introduced in this article.

sentences.text: 日本の　8つの　紅葉ツアー
sentences.translation: Japan's 8 autumn-leaf tours

sentences.text: 1. 北海道黒岳ロープウェイ・旭山動物園・白金青い池秋のバスツアー(札幌から)
sentences.translation: 1. Hokkaido Kurodake Ropeway, Asahiyama Zoo, and Shirogane Blue Pond Autumn Bus Tour (from Sapporo)

sentences.text: 2. 鳴子峡の紅葉と銀山温泉日帰りバスツアー(仙台から)
sentences.translation: 2. Naruko Gorge Autumn Leaves and Ginzan Onsen Day Bus Tour (from Sendai)

sentences.text: 3. 那須の紅葉とあしかがフラワーパーク イルミネーション日帰りツアー(東京から)
sentences.translation: 3. Nasu Autumn Leaves and Ashikaga Flower Park Illumination Day Tour (from Tokyo)

sentences.text: 4. 富士山と河口湖日帰り紅葉ツアー (東京から)
sentences.translation: 4. Mt. Fuji and Lake Kawaguchi Day Autumn-Leaf Tour (from Tokyo)

sentences.text: 5. 三島スカイウォーク・修善寺・熱海梅園日帰りツアー (東京から)
sentences.translation: 5. Mishima Skywalk, Shuzenji, and Atami Plum Garden Day Tour (from Tokyo)

sentences.text: 6. 川越日帰り紅葉ツアー(東京から)
sentences.translation: 6. Kawagoe Day Autumn-Leaf Tour (from Tokyo)

sentences.text: 7. 日光東照宮と華厳ノ滝日帰り紅葉ツアー(東京から)
sentences.translation: 7. Nikko Toshogu Shrine and Kegon Falls Day Autumn-Leaf Tour (from Tokyo)

sentences.text: 8. 耶馬渓日帰り紅葉ツアー (福岡から)
sentences.translation: 8. Yabakei Day Autumn-Leaf Tour (from Fukuoka)

sentences.text: 1. 北海道黒岳ロープウェイ・旭山動物園・白金青い池秋のバスツアー(札幌から)
sentences.translation: 1. Hokkaido Kurodake Ropeway, Asahiyama Zoo, and Shirogane Blue Pond Autumn Bus Tour (from Sapporo)

sentences.text: 札幌から　出発する　このバスツアーでは　ロープウェイに　乗って　その下に　広がる　オレンジ色の　海のような　景色を　見る　すばらしい　体験が　できます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: On this bus tour departing from Sapporo, you can have the wonderful experience of riding the ropeway and viewing the orange, sea-like scenery spreading out below.

sentences.text: そして　北海道の　自然を　楽しむことが　できます。
sentences.translation: And you can enjoy Hokkaido's nature.

sentences.text: 日本で　1番　早く　紅葉が　始まる　北海道の　景色を　楽しんで　ください。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means
particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: Please enjoy the scenery of Hokkaido, where the autumn leaves start earliest in Japan.

sentences.text: 次に　旭山動物園で、レッサーパンダや　ホッキョクグマの　子どもなど、かわいい　動物を　見ることが　できます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: Next, at Asahiyama Zoo, you can see cute animals such as red pandas and polar bear cubs.

sentences.text: 最後に　美瑛町にある「白金の青い池」に　行きます。
sentences.translation: Finally, you go to the "Blue Pond of Shirogane" in Biei Town.

sentences.text: 自然の　青い　水が　とても　きれいな　池です。
sentences.translation: It is a pond with beautifully clear, naturally blue water.

sentences.text: 日帰り旅行は、旅行の　最後の　日まで　楽しみたいと　考えている人に　オススメです。
sentences.translation: Day trips are recommended for people who want to keep enjoying their trip right up to the last day.

sentences.text: 札幌駅を　出発して、札幌駅に　戻ってくる　ツアーです。
sentences.translation: It is a tour that departs from Sapporo Station and returns to Sapporo Station.

sentences.text: 2.鳴子峡の紅葉と銀山温泉日帰りバスツアー(仙台から)
sentences.translation: 2. Naruko Gorge Autumn Leaves and Ginzan Onsen Day Bus Tour (from Sendai)

sentences.text: 仙台から　出発する　バスツアーで、日本の　秋を　楽しみましょう。
sentences.translation: Let's enjoy Japan's autumn on this bus tour departing from Sendai.

sentences.text: このツアーでは　最初に　銀山温泉に　行きます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: On this tour, you first go to Ginzan Onsen.

sentences.text: 銀山温泉は昔、銀を　とっていた場所です。
sentences.translation: Ginzan Onsen was once a place where silver was mined.

sentences.text: 今は　昔から　ある　旅館が　並んで　います。

tokens.gloss: to line up, to be lined up
particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: Now, inns that have stood since long ago line the streets.

sentences.text: 歴史を　感じる　美しい　景色で　有名です。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: It's famous for beautiful scenery that lets you feel its history.

sentences.text: 銀山温泉の　町を　歩きながら、昔の　景色を　楽しんで、おいしい　おかしや　伝統的な　和菓子を　食べることも　できます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means
sweets, treats (from おかし; also lit. "strange, funny")

sentences.translation: While walking through the town of Ginzan Onsen, you can enjoy the old-time scenery and also eat delicious treats and traditional Japanese sweets.

sentences.text: それから、鳴子峡の　とても　きれいな　紅葉を　楽しむことが　できます。
sentences.translation: After that, you can enjoy the very beautiful autumn leaves of Naruko Gorge.

sentences.text: 森のなかを　通っている　大深沢橋と　紅葉を　一緒に　見ることが　できる　場所が　あります。

tokens.gloss: to pass through, to run through (also: to commute)

sentences.translation: There's a spot where you can see the Ofukazawa Bridge running through the forest together with the autumn leaves.

sentences.text: そこでは　とても　すばらしい　写真を　とることが　できます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: There, you can take truly wonderful photos.

sentences.text: 3. 那須の紅葉とあしかがフラワーパーク イルミネーション日帰りツアー(東京から)
sentences.translation: 3. Nasu Autumn Leaves and Ashikaga Flower Park Illumination Day Tour (from Tokyo)

sentences.text: 東京・新宿を　出発し、自然と　美しい　文化遺産を　楽しむ　ツアーです。
sentences.translation: This tour departs from Shinjuku, Tokyo, and lets you enjoy nature along with beautiful cultural heritage.

sentences.text: 100種類以上の　料理が　並ぶ　レストランで、ビュッフェスタイルの　お昼ご飯を　食べられますよ。

tokens.gloss: to line up, to be lined up
particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: You can eat a buffet-style lunch at a restaurant offering over 100 kinds of dishes.

sentences.text: 那須に　行くまでに　見られる　景色は　とても　きれいです。
sentences.translation: The scenery you see on the way to Nasu is very beautiful.

sentences.text: 白い　火山石で　できた　大谷観音や、あしかがフラワーパークの　きれいな　イルミネーションを　ぜひ　見てください。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: Be sure to see the Oya Kannon, carved from white volcanic rock, and the beautiful illuminations at Ashikaga Flower Park.

sentences.text: 那須ロープウェイから　見る　紅葉は、本当に　美しいんです！
sentences.translation: The autumn leaves seen from the Nasu Ropeway are truly beautiful!

sentences.text: 展望台から　見る　那須の　山や　火山など、見るべき　景色が　たくさん　あります。

tokens.gloss: should, ought to (classical auxiliary, as in -べき)

sentences.translation: There's so much scenery worth seeing from the observation deck, such as Nasu's mountains and volcanoes.

sentences.text: 4. 富士山と河口湖日帰り紅葉ツアー (東京から)
sentences.translation: 4. Mt. Fuji and Lake Kawaguchi Day Autumn-Leaf Tour (from Tokyo)

sentences.text: このツアーは、富士山と　河口湖の　すばらしい　景色を　いっしょに　見られる　心と　体を　リフレッシュできる　日帰り旅行です！
sentences.translation: This is a day trip where you can see the wonderful scenery of Mt. Fuji and Lake Kawaguchi together, refreshing both mind and body!

sentences.text: 東京から　出発する　このツアーでは、富士山と　紅葉を　楽しめます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means
can enjoy (potential form of 楽しむ)

sentences.translation: On this tour departing from Tokyo, you can enjoy Mt. Fuji and the autumn leaves.

sentences.text: 忍野八海に　ある　8つの　きれいな　湧水にも　驚く　と思いますよ。
sentences.translation: I think you'll also be amazed by the 8 beautiful springs at Oshino Hakkai.

sentences.text: 富士山の　紅葉を　見たあとに　忍野八海に　行きます。
sentences.translation: After viewing the autumn leaves of Mt. Fuji, you go to Oshino Hakkai.

sentences.text: だから、帰る　時間まで、忍野八海を　ゆっくり　見ることが　できます。
sentences.translation: So you can take your time looking around Oshino Hakkai until it's time to head back.

sentences.text: 5. 三島スカイウォーク・修善寺・熱海梅園日帰りツアー (東京から)
sentences.translation: 5. Mishima Skywalk, Shuzenji, and Atami Plum Garden Day Tour (from Tokyo)

sentences.text: このツアーは　秋だけの　伊豆半島　日帰りツアーです。
sentences.translation: This tour is an autumn-only day trip to the Izu Peninsula.

sentences.text: このツアーに参加すれば、伝統的な　建物や　きれいな　紅葉を　見ることが　できます。
sentences.translation: If you join this tour, you can see traditional buildings and beautiful autumn leaves.

sentences.text: このツアーでは、日本で　1番　長い　吊り橋「三島スカイウォーク」を　渡ります。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means
particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: On this tour, you cross Japan's longest suspension bridge, the "Mishima Skywalk."

sentences.text: 三島スカイウォークを　渡りながら、遠くに　見える　富士山、駿河湾、伊豆半島の　山を　見ることが　できます。

tokens.gloss: to be visible, to be able to see

sentences.translation: While crossing the Mishima Skywalk, you can see Mt. Fuji, Suruga Bay, and the mountains of the Izu Peninsula in the distance.

sentences.text: そして、日本で　有名な　お寺の　修善寺と　きれいな　紅葉を　楽しめる　熱海梅園を　訪れます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means
can enjoy (potential form of 楽しむ)

sentences.translation: And you visit Shuzenji, a temple famous throughout Japan, and Atami Plum Garden, where you can enjoy beautiful autumn leaves.

sentences.text: 少ない　人数の　ツアーなので、参加している　人と　友達になって　ツアーを　楽しめますよ。

tokens.gloss: can enjoy (potential form of 楽しむ)

sentences.translation: Since it's a small-group tour, you can make friends with fellow participants and enjoy the tour together.

sentences.text: 6. 川越日帰り紅葉ツアー(東京から)
sentences.translation: 6. Kawagoe Day Autumn-Leaf Tour (from Tokyo)

sentences.text: 江戸時代の　景色が　残っている　川越の　古い　町を　散歩しながら、美しい　紅葉を　楽しみましょう。
sentences.translation: Let's enjoy the beautiful autumn leaves while strolling through the old town of Kawagoe, where scenery from the Edo period still remains.

sentences.text: 川越は、東京から　近くて、江戸時代の　建物が　残る　町で　有名です。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: Kawagoe, close to Tokyo, is famous as a town where Edo-period buildings still remain.

sentences.text: 伝統的な　おかしを　食べられる　店や、　おいしい　レストランが　並んでいる　商店街も　あります。

tokens.gloss: to line up, to be lined up
particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: There's also a shopping street lined with shops selling traditional sweets and delicious restaurants.

sentences.text: 川越には、紅葉を　楽しめる　お寺や　神社も　あります。

tokens.gloss: can enjoy (potential form of 楽しむ)

sentences.translation: In Kawagoe, there are also temples and shrines where you can enjoy the autumn leaves.

sentences.text: ツアーでは、喜多院、中院、川越城本丸御殿、氷川神社などを　訪れる予定です。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means
Kita (place name component, as in Kitain)

sentences.translation: On the tour, you're scheduled to visit places such as Kitain, Nakain, the Honmaru Palace of Kawagoe Castle, and Hikawa Shrine.

sentences.text: 7. 日光東照宮と華厳ノ滝日帰り紅葉ツアー(東京から)
sentences.translation: 7. Nikko Toshogu Shrine and Kegon Falls Day Autumn-Leaf Tour (from Tokyo)

sentences.text: 日光では、山　ぜんぶが　きれいな　赤色に　なります。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: In Nikko, the whole mountainside turns a beautiful red.

sentences.text: そして、世界遺産の　すばらしい　建物が　あなたを　待っています。
sentences.translation: And the wonderful buildings of a World Heritage site await you.

sentences.text: 日光は　自然も　世界遺産も　楽しめるので、1年中　人気の　場所です。

tokens.gloss: can enjoy (potential form of 楽しむ)

sentences.translation: Since Nikko lets you enjoy both nature and a World Heritage site, it's a popular spot all year round.

sentences.text: このツアーでは、日光東照宮、中禅寺湖、そして　高さ　97メートルの　華厳ノ滝を　見に行きます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: On this tour, you go to see Nikko Toshogu Shrine, Lake Chuzenji, and the 97-meter-high Kegon Falls.

sentences.text: 歴史と　伝統を　感じられる　世界遺産　日光東照宮を　ぜひ　楽しんで　ください。

tokens.gloss: to feel (variant form of 感じる)
particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: Be sure to enjoy Nikko Toshogu Shrine, a World Heritage site where you can feel history and tradition.

sentences.text: 8. 耶馬渓日帰り紅葉ツアー (福岡から)
sentences.translation: 8. Yabakei Day Autumn-Leaf Tour (from Fukuoka)

sentences.text: 九州地方には、美しい　紅葉の　場所が　いくつか　あります。
sentences.translation: The Kyushu region has several places with beautiful autumn leaves.

sentences.text: しかし　車か　バスだけで　行くことが　できる　場所が　多いです。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: However, many of these places can only be reached by car or bus.

sentences.text: 福岡から　出発する　この日帰りツアーは、九州で　有名な　紅葉を　楽しむ　場所の　耶馬渓に　行きます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: This day tour departing from Fukuoka goes to Yabakei, a spot in Kyushu famous for its autumn leaves.

sentences.text: このツアーでは、自然と　素晴らしい　文化遺産を　いっしょに　楽しめる　3つの　場所を　訪れます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means
can enjoy (potential form of 楽しむ)

sentences.translation: On this tour, you visit three places where you can enjoy nature and wonderful cultural heritage together.

sentences.text: まず、猿飛千壺峡の　吊り橋から　素晴らしい　秋の　景色を　楽しみます。
sentences.translation: First, you enjoy the wonderful autumn scenery from the suspension bridge at Sarutobi Senko Gorge.

sentences.text: そのあと、紅葉と　御霊神社の　建築を　楽しみます。
sentences.translation: After that, you enjoy the autumn leaves and the architecture of Goryo Shrine.

sentences.text: それから、渓石園の　きれいな　イルミネーションと　夜の　紅葉を　見ます。
sentences.translation: Then, you see the beautiful illuminations and nighttime autumn leaves at Keisekien.

sentences.text: 日本の　紅葉を　ぜひ　見に来てください
sentences.translation: Come see Japan's autumn leaves for yourself

sentences.text: 秋は、日本で　美しい　景色が　見られるときです。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: Autumn is the season when you can see beautiful scenery in Japan.

sentences.text: この記事で　紹介した　ツアーに　参加すれば、車や　バスに　乗らないと　行きにくい　場所で　紅葉や　美しい　景色を　楽しむことが　できます。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means
car (and the like) — 車 + listing particle や
particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: If you join the tours introduced in this article, you can enjoy autumn leaves and beautiful scenery in places that are hard to reach without a car or bus.

sentences.text: そして　ガイドが　その場所について　案内してくれます。

tokens.gloss: to attach; (as ~について) concerning, regarding

sentences.translation: And a guide will show you around and explain about each place.

sentences.text: ツアーに　参加して　日本の　紅葉を　楽しんで　ください。

tokens.gloss: particle: location of action ("at, in") or means

sentences.translation: Please join a tour and enjoy Japan's autumn leaves.
